verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public REST API covering transactions, budgets, expenses with receipt upload, payments and vendors, onboarding and webhooks, plus scoped token auth, a maintained changelog, Postman collections and an llms.txt index. An official MCP server is also documented for agent use. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard path (probes of openapi.json and swagger.json returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
